title: Honor MagicPad 4 (12.1) and X10 Pro Max arrive
description: Alongside the brand new Magic9 series phones, Honor also announced a pair of new Android tablets with the MagicPad 4 12.1 and the more budget-friendly X10 Pro Max. MagicPad 4 (12.1) The MagicPad 4 (12.1) should not be confused with the MagicPad4, which launched back in June. That one brings a 12.3-inch OLED display alongside the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chip and a 10,100mAh battery. As its name suggests, the new MagicPad 4 (12.1) features a marginally smaller 12.1-inch IPS LCD with a 1,872 x 3,000 px resolution, a 165Hz refresh rate and 700 nits of brightness. title: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max sold 1.3 million units in China during the first week, beating the 17 Pros
description: During the pre-order period in China, retailers quickly ran out of available iPhone 18 Pro series units – according to estimates, 7 million units were pre-ordered. Some stores saw double the revenue compared to the 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max launch last year. This momentum has carried over into actual sales too. According to information by blogger RD Observation, the new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max have sold approximately 1.3 million units during the first week of availability in China. This is 15% more units than what the 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max sold last year during their first week....

title: The HMD 106 Pure appears out of nowhere - a super cheap 2G phone with FM radio
description: One of our readers sent us a tip about the HMD 106 Pure – a feature phone that appears on an online store in Pakistan, but that we couldn’t find on HMD.com. We did find an HMD 105 Pure that uses an older design, though. The HMD 106 Pure looks a lot like the HMD 101. However, it’s powered by a different chipset, the Unisoc 6531E. It still only has basic GSM connectivity – this means that it can’t be used in regions that have already or will soon sundown their 2G networks. This chip is used in other models, e.g. the HMD 102, but that one has a camera – if you can call the 320 x 240p module a...

title: The Honor Watch 6 Pro has a 1.5" dual-layer OLED display, HRV and CGM tracking
description: A few months ago, Honor unveiled the impressive Watch 6 – it measured only 10.8mm thick, but packed a massive 980mAh battery for up to 35 days of typical usage. There’s also the Plus model with a 1,000mAh Si/C battery. Now the company is unveiling a more capable Pro model that trades battery endurance for features. The Honor Watch 6 Pro impresses with a 1.5” dual-layer OLED display (466 x 466px). It has 4,500 nits peak global brightness and, if a smaller region of the screen is on, it can go up to 5,500 nits. The watch measures 46.3mm x 46.3mm x 11.6mm. The Honor Watch 6 Pro has a...

title: The Oppo F35 series is going official next week
description: Oppo is celebrating 10 years of its F series in India and has announced the launch date for the upcoming F35 lineup. The company has also revealed the design and color options of the two phones. The Oppo F35 series will launch in India on October 5 and will include a standard model and the F35 Pro. Oppo has shared a couple of teasers for the F35 and F35 Pro, revealing their available color options. The F35 Pro will be available in three color options, with two featuring a textured rear panel. It will be offered in Orange, Light Blue, and Matte Black. Meanwhile, the...

title: Honor Magic9 and Magic9 Super Edition announced
description: Honor is unveiling three new flagship models today – the Pro Max is covered in a separate article, here we will look at the Magic9 and the Magic9 Super Edition. The Honor Magic9 is a relatively small (6.37” display) camera powerhouse with a large 8,000mAh battery. The Honor Magic9 Super Edition brings an even bigger 11,000mAh battery (and has a 6.81” screen), but its most interesting feature may be the 30,000 rpm active cooling fan. Honor Magic9 The Honor Magic 9 is built around a 6.37” display. This is smaller than the 6.58” display of the previous vanilla model, the Magic8....

title: Here's when the OnePlus 16 is launching
description: After recently revealing the color options and full camera details of the upcoming OnePlus 16, the company has now announced the phone’s launch date in China. The OnePlus 16 will launch in China on October 12. The company announced the launch date at its 2026 OnePlus Gaming Conference in China, where it also detailed the upcoming flagship’s gaming capabilities. The OnePlus 16 was recently confirmed to be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. title: Honor Magic9 Pro Max arrives with 200MP main cam, ARRI camera tuning and SD 8 Elite Gen 6 Extreme chip
description: The Magic9 Pro Max is Honor’s top-tier phone, and it checks all of the boxes for a late 2026 Android flagship. Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 (✓), dual 200 MP cameras(✓), a massive 8,800mAh Si-C battery with 100W wired and 80W wireless charging (✓). It’s also positioning itself as a professional-grade video camera alongside Honor’s budding partnership with German camera maker ARRI. Magic9 Pro Max gets a new 23mm equivalent 200MP main cam armed with a 1/1.28-inch sensor and f/1.6 aperture. It’s paired with an 85mm equivalent 200MP periscope telephoto lens using a 1/1.4-inch sensor...

title: vivo X Fold6 global and India launch date leaked
description: The vivo X Fold6 made its debut in China in June and is expected to launch globally soon. While vivo has yet to announce an official launch date, a tipster has now leaked the global and India launch dates for the company’s latest foldable. According to the tipster, the vivo X Fold6 will make its global debut on October 1, four months after its China launch. Meanwhile, the foldable is tipped to launch in India on October 6. title: Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W review
description: The Xiaomi MDY-20-EB, commonly known by its product name Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W, is exactly what its overly long title suggests. It’s an ultra-thin power bank that attaches magnetically to your phone, has a 5000mAh capacity, and can provide up to 15W of power wirelessly. The product was globally announced back in February and has been available in select markets, but was recently also launched in India, along with a couple of other models, like the Xiaomi Magnetic Power Bank 10000 45W. The Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W is priced in India at INR...

title: vivo X500 Pro Max unboxing and hands-on
description: We had the pleasure of attending the vivo X500 Pro Max unveiling in China, but we're now back at HQ and can get our unboxing hats on! And boy, is there a lot to unpack here. First, a word on the phone itself. This is vivo's latest premium flagship that sits just below the Ultra model (in theory more than in practice), and packs some truly impressive hardware. It's got a spanking-new 2nm SoC in the Dimensity 9600 Pro, packaged with up to 16GB of RAM. It has an 8,000mAh battery inside - that's eight and three zeros, wow! title: Xiaomi 18 Pro/Pro Max, vivo X500, Pro/Pro Max are all official, Week 39 in review
description: It's been quite a busy week, and as we're now approaching the end of September, the calm and quiet of summer is truly behind us. Tech is in full swing again! So let's recap the past seven days. Qualcomm unveiled its latest flagship chipsets – the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6. Both are built on TSMC's 2nm process and bring upgraded Oryon CPU cores, Adreno GPUs, and improved AI capabilities. title: Deals: Google’s Pixel 11 series gets price cuts, Samsung Galaxy Z8 foldables discounted
description: The Google Pixel 11 series is currently available at a discount, along with last year’s Pixel 10 Pro. Samsung’s latest Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Galaxy Z Fold8, and Galaxy Z Flip8 are also on sale. Meanwhile, Xiaomi’s 17 series and 17T lineup are available at discounted prices as well. The Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL are available with discounts, although the deals are limited to the 256GB variants. Notably, the Pixel 11 Pro deal is part of a bundle that includes a pair of Pixel Buds Pro 2 at no extra cost. ...

title: Weekly poll: what do you think of the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max?
description: Hot on the heels of the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and 8 Elite Gen 6 announcement, Xiaomi unveiled two flagships featuring the new chips. These two are already on sale in China and Xiaomi has confirmed that the Xiaomi 18 Pro series will be available globally. “When?” and “How much?” are questions for another date. We wanted to get your first reaction to the new models – do you like the direction in which Xiaomi is taking its flagship series? Would you buy one and which one? Let’s do a quick introduction – the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max is the big 6.9” flagship. It gets the “Extreme”...

title: Weekly poll results: the Redmi Note 17 Pro and Note 17 Pro Max feel like a step back
description: While they were not universally loved, the Redmi Note 15 series from Xiaomi got a positive response in a poll a year ago. The Pro+ model was clearly the fan favorite, but the Pro did well for itself too. Last week we polled your opinion on their successors – and the results aren’t nearly as good. To summarize the results, the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max is overpriced. The regular 17 Pro is also overpriced – and people would rather have the Pro Max, anyway. Sticking to the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max for now, it found some fans, but most would-be buyers are put off by the price. The price hike...

description: WhatsApp is currently in the process of redesigning its Android app, according to a new report. The redesign is right now focused on the app’s navigation bar, which is getting a new look and a new item inside of it. The image below shows the rough state of the current development - this is definitely not the final version of the redesign, since the Meta AI button appears in two different places. title: Apple code confirms the main specs of the next entry-level iPad
description: Apple launched its latest entry-level iPad in March 2025, and its successor has been expected to arrive about two years after that in spring 2027. Ahead of that, a new report brings us the upcoming tablet's main specs, courtesy of "details found in Apple's code". So, the next entry-level iPad will be powered by the A19 chip, paired with 8GB of RAM. That's a solid upgrade over the existing model's A16 chip and 6GB of RAM. title: Deals: Galaxy Z Fold7 vs. Galaxy Z Fold8 and Z Fold8 Ultra, plus Galaxy S26 FE alternatives
description: Last week, we focused on the iPhone 18 Pro series launch. This week we’ll have a look at what has been going on with Galaxy phones. Let’s start with the foldables. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold7 – last year’s book-style foldable – is available for $1,350. This is $550 less than what its replacement costs, the Z Fold8 Ultra. Both are surprisingly thin (8.9mm) and light (215g) for foldables, but the new one brings a tangible increase in battery size – 600mAh over the 4,400mAh battery of the Z Fold7. description: Apple unveiled the first HomePod Mini in October 2020. It was initially offered in white and midnight, then later in blue, orange, and yellow. Now, an image of the yet-to-be-launched HomePod Mini 2, shared by MacRumors, shows the speaker in all its colors. The image below shows the HomePod Mini 2 in five colors: pink, white, green, blue, and midnight. Pink and green are new colors, while the blue shade is slightly lighter than the original HomePod Mini's. description: Samsung was expected to unveil the Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra this month, but rumors now suggest it will make these tablets official next month - October 7, to be precise.
